column7: This is one of the best budget smartphones from Samsung. The metal unibody feels premium in hand, display is crisp and vibrant, and call quality is super clear.

column6: Great battery backup and sleek look
column7: Battery easily lasts a full working day with heavy whatsapp and social media usage. Fast fingerprint sensor on the front. Camera takes crisp daylight photos.
Good display and solid build quality. UI is snappy for routine tasks like browsing and YouTube. Sound quality through headphones is very good.
Samsung brand reliability with premium metallic design. Front selfie camera with flash is great for night shots. Very satisfied with delivery and phone.
3GB RAM handles normal multitasking smoothly. Fingerprint scanner works 9 out of 10 times. Screen glass is tough and clear.
Rear camera struggles terribly in indoor lighting and evening shots. Photos look noisy and soft. Expected better sensor from Samsung.
Camera quality is below average in low light conditions. Outdoor shots are fine, but inside the house pictures are grainy and lack details.
Photos in daylight are crisp and colors look natural. Indoor photos are okay if you turn on the flash.

column6: Camera is blurry in room light
column7: Night photos are very blurry and grainy. Autofocus takes too long in dimly lit rooms.
Device has extreme overheating issue during charging. Back panel becomes scalding hot to touch within 20 minutes of plug-in. Worried about battery hazard.
Serious heating problem while charging with original adapter. Phone heats up to an unbearable temperature near the camera module and shuts down automatically.
Overheating during basic charging is alarming. The metal frame burned my hand slightly when picking it up from the charger. Service center was unhelpful.
